# Lucille Lortel Award for Outstanding Lifetime Achievement

| location = United States
| holder = Mia Katigbak, (2026)
| website =
}}
The Lucille Lortel Award for Lifetime Achievement is a special award presented annually at the Lucille Lortel Awards to honor an individual for excellence in Off-Broadway theatre.
